summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting the grant of 14,060 warrants to employees under its Articles of Association. Each warrant has an exercise price of $265.57 per share, equal to the closing price on the grant date. Vesting occurs 25% after one year and 75% monthly thereafter, subject to continued service. This is a routine equity compensation grant, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
